# King IPTV Player

> King IPTV Player is a free, ad-free IPTV player for iPhone (iOS 17+) and Android (7.0+), made by ZaPlatform (developer: Mohamed "Zak" ElZoghbi). It plays the user's own M3U / M3U8 playlist or Xtream Codes login. It is a player only: it hosts, sells and provides no channels or content, and it is not affiliated with any IPTV provider.

Last updated: 2026-10-07

## Key facts
- What it is: an IPTV player app. It shows nothing until the user adds a playlist from a provider they already use.
- Does it provide channels? No. No channels, playlists, subscriptions or content of any kind.
- Platforms: iPhone with iOS 17 or later (the iPhone app can also be installed on iPad); Android phones and tablets with Android 7.0 or later. No Android TV, Apple TV or Chromecast version.
- Sources: Xtream Codes API login (server URL, username, password); M3U or M3U8 playlist by link or file. Several sources can be kept and switched between.
- Live TV: category picker with channel counts, search across the whole playlist, favourites per source. With an Xtream Codes login, live channels show now and next from the provider's EPG.
- Films and series: films with plot and cast, series with seasons and episodes, resume where you left off.
- Player: picture-in-picture, subtitle and audio track choice, a Stream info panel (resolution, codecs, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames). It plays with the system player first (AVFoundation on iPhone, ExoPlayer on Android) and switches to libVLC automatically when a stream fails.
- Not included: channels or playlists, catch-up, recording.
- Price: free on both stores. No ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases.
- Privacy: no account, no ads, no advertising ID, no server of ours. Only anonymous usage statistics via Firebase Analytics (screens opened, whether streams play; never logins, links or channel names). Provider credentials are encrypted on the device (iOS keychain, Android keystore) and sent only to the provider's server.
- Support: support@zaplatform.com
